info.name: Mastercard Bill Payment Validator Account Opening Benefit-Allocations-Card-Management API
Mastercard Replace Card Number for a Cardholder

items.docs: Replaces the card number associated with the user. The benefits on the old card number are expired, and the same set of benefits are applied to new card number.

info.name: Mastercard Freeze/unfreeze a Card for Benefits

items.docs: Freezes a card for benefits, or unfreezes the card for benefits. isFrozen set to true freezes the card, and isFrozen set to false unfreezes the card.
